articles.title: This Bird's Wings Are Made for Sharp Turns
articles.summary: Scientists found the nightjar's wings are built for sharp turns, and the bird pushes forward even when raising its wings.

articles.title: A Desert Plant That Cools Itself by 'Sweating'
articles.summary: Scientists found that a Death Valley shrub survives extreme heat by releasing water vapor to cool its leaves.

articles.title: Kodak Once Had a Nuclear Machine in Its Basement
articles.summary: From 1975 to 2006, Kodak used a carefully controlled nuclear machine to make neutrons for testing materials.
